anchors.what: an account balance is an ElGamal pair (Left, Right)
a new balance is an encryption of zero under the account's own public key
each payload adds a per-account ciphertext delta built from the statement (C[i], D)
the stored balance is updated by ciphertext addition only
ciphertext addition is component-wise point addition
opening a balance uses the holder's secret key
the reported supply is the emission formula, not a sum of balances
consensus accepts a payload on one proof boolean
the node's own integrity report states that encrypted value is invisible to it

Q-CS2.question: Is the aggregate of balances bound by a publicly checkable conservation relation?
Q-CS2.reason: every balance is a ciphertext under its holder's own key and changes only by ciphertext addition; opening any balance needs that holder's secret key, and no aggregate key or aggregate opening exists in the code; consensus checks one proof boolean per payload and never compares any aggregate with the formula supply, which RPC reports as CalcSupply
Q-CS2.status: answered (INTERPRETATION of SRC; audit refutes by default)

certificate.consequence: a complete public accounting of the supply of this ledger cannot be derived from public data; every aggregate over hidden balances is unbounded while DC2 is open
